description: Exploit, work removal in group 3, extending E059's finding that one 8x8 group-2 conv cost ~0.73 s for only -0.15 pp. First microbenchmark ms/step per phase on the current recipe (graphed, Muon included) for group 3 at 3 vs 2 convs. If the 2-conv version saves >=4%, cut group 3 from 3 convs to 2 (net 2/2/2, airbench94-style) at width 576, keeping the pooling position and head. Remove the 576x5184 matrix from the batched-NS shape groups; it is the largest Muon matrix. Hold epochs, resolutions, schedule, ls, head scale, BN-bias multiplier, freezing and the bias window fixed. Recapture all graphs in build. Check that eval returns finite [B,100] logits for B in {1, 7, 513, 1024}. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12. If the microbenchmark saves <3%, log it and do not run. Run this after the BN-bias 16x idea, on whichever base is then the tip.
